target_customer: Restaurants, small retailers and distributors buying fresh produce and freight
problem: Fresh produce supply chains are slow and wasteful. GETASAP sells same-day produce and an AI freight brokerage.
business_model: Produce distribution margin plus freight brokerage fees

founders.name: Raghav Arora
founders.background_notes: YC page says he started GETASAP at 14; education and employers not listed

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly operational: sourcing, cold chain and logistics. Voice AI dispatch adds some software work.

defensibility.rationale: Supply chain relationships and fulfillment infrastructure take time to build, but produce distribution is a competitive low margin market.

market_need_then: Small retailers and restaurants need fast fresh supply. Industry press in 2025 noted Amazon expanding same-day perishables, indicating demand for speed.

branding.name_origin: ASAP is the common acronym for as soon as possible; no founder source states the naming story.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and confident with lines like 'Order by midnight. On your shelves by afternoon.'

branding.brand_signature: Same-day speed promise built into the name
branding.community_and_virality: TechCrunch named it among the most sought-after YC Summer 2025 Demo Day startups

brand_strength.rationale: The name communicates the speed promise directly and drew Demo Day press, but it is generic and easily confused with the common acronym.

outcome_analysis: GETASAP is a 30 person Summer 2025 company running produce delivery and AI freight, with named retail and distribution customers on its site. TechCrunch reported a General Catalyst round and a top of batch valuation, though amounts are unverified. Its trajectory depends on margins in a hard logistics business.
notes: Unverified: Seedtable lists about 3.45M to 3.5M pre-seed in July 2025 led by General Catalyst. Amount not recorded. Sources conflict on location (San Francisco vs San Jose), team size and ages. The YC page lists a related GETASAP ASIA entity. Competitor list empty because sources found were undated.
